role: implementer; not an independent final reviewer

implementation.evidence_preservation: Require preservation of ephemeral failure inputs/logs/dumps/screenshots before rerun/clean/rebuild, recording source, hash and controlled path. Missing originals do not support a firm causal claim.
implementation.calibrated_oracle: Publish an executable Bash wrapper, including its invocation, around a trusted project-specific probe. Successful classifications good/bad/untestable map to Git statuses 0/1/125. Any process failure or unrecognized classification aborts with 128.
implementation.objective_boundary: A build failure is bad when testing a build regression. Only a revision that prevents testing a different objective is untestable. Unknown and infrastructure errors abort.
implementation.bisection_qualification: Calibrate known-good/bad for the same objective; keep wrapper and probe outside the checkout being switched; preserve git bisect log and reported candidates. A skipped boundary retains uncertainty. Current checkout HEAD is not the identified first-bad result.
implementation.context_cost: Consolidated duplicate preconditions and regression requirements into the primary workflow; directory bytes unchanged. No additional Skill, runtime dependency, model invocation or new gate.
implementation.published_execution: The final tests execute the rendered reference code verbatim, adding only its trailing newline. The first GREEN had an invocation appended by the fixture; self-review moved that invocation into the published block before the final GREEN.

retained_methods.method: Read-only first; destructive action authorization; single hypothesis; no root-cause claim without evidence
Direct causal chain without fabricated hypotheses or negative results; ranked alternatives; evidence-backed 5-Why; code/config/module/input bisection
Single-variable experiments, positive/negative observations, irreproducible branches, E2/E3 falsification and reuse of evidence with the same identity
Repair Note including passed-scope preservation, minimal rerun, rollback anchor and root-cause status; distinct schema/semantic/parallel/device repair paths
Same-condition old-red/new-green regression and affected passing paths; two uninformative iterations stop; signal coverage and measurement distortion; needs-fix if unresolved
Single local reproduction, intermittent failure count/N and confidence boundary; fixed seed/time/network/concurrency/files; one green insufficient
Input shrinking, state capture, read-only instrumentation, controlled configurations; dual-mic/MCU/async timelines, scheduling, IRQ/state ordering, owner and late completion
Controlled simulation/static assertions remain proxy evidence when original-device reproduction is unavailable

Sanitizer known-defect controls including UBSan diagnostics despite exit 0; embedded diagnosis branches; AI tool version/source/config/git history attribution; verified read-only transport/debugger; not-run reporting
retained_methods.location: Primary evidence/command sections; both unchanged references retain their baseline SHA256

authoritative_git_semantics.result: Generic run semantics are 0 good, 1..127 except 125 bad, 125 skip, >=128 abort. Git 2.52 additionally rechecks the known-good commit after first 126/127 and can abort if that status is reproduced. This implementation does not claim that every raw 126/127 is blindly classified as bad; the wrapper normalizes all project-process failures to 128.
authoritative_git_semantics.source_use: Behavioral semantics only; no upstream implementation copied.
